title: Hands-free reading, any page
caption: Press Space and the page scrolls smoothly at your pace, with a speed bar and time left in the corner.

title: Controls right on the page
caption: Pause, slow down or speed up from the floating bar, or just press + and - while you read.

title: Your speed, remembered per site
caption: Set a slow pace for recipes and a faster one for feeds; each site keeps its own speed.

title: Ready in one click
caption: A short hint on first run shows the keys, and every setting is saved automatically.

title: Looks right in dark mode
caption: The popup follows your system theme, so it never glares at night.
